title: input.pointer payload
description: Tablet → Mac, at most 120 per second; deltas are summed since the previous message. The Mac moves first, then presses or releases the buttons that differ from the previous message. Omitted fields are 0.

dy.description: pointer movement, Mac points, positive = down

buttons.description: buttons held after this event: 1 left, 2 right

scrollX.description: pixels the content moves, positive = right

scrollY.description: pixels the content moves, positive = down
